Proposition
[Knot-complement fundamental group] \group thurston-ch01-topology Source: thurston:page-0010

The fundamental group of a knot complement is isomorphic to $\mathbb Z$ exactly when the knot is trivial.
Proof

\sketch The trivial knot has complement with fundamental group $\mathbb Z$; the converse is the Papakyriakopoulos theorem.

□
